elements.element: Cap applies mutually to both parties
elements.evidence: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD — anchored to an unspecified 'immediately preceding' period, not to the claim, and narrowed to hosting and support compensation

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000 floor, expressed as the greater of (a) and (b)
elements.evidence: EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) ... AND (B) USD 1,000,000
NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out: breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS ... A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY ... OBLIGATIONS
BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out: infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) ... AND (B) USD 1,000,000 — a greater-of cap with a preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor, not a cap of 12 months' fees

reasons: The locked preferred level fails on the fee limb: the cap is measured by 'THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD', which is an event/period anchor limited to hosting and support compensation rather than 'fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim'.
Fix by replacing the limb (a) wording with 'the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim' so the measurement period is anchored to the claim and covers all fees.

All preferred carve-outs (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP infringement), the mutual consequential-damages exclusion, the USD 1,000,000 floor and the payment-obligations carve-out are expressly present; the payment-obligation sentence does state that Client's obligation to pay amounts due is not damages, so the deterministic flag on that point appears to misfire.

Fallback is not independently satisfied as literally drafted because the cap is a greater-of with the preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor rather than a cap of 12 months' fees; the carve-out set does satisfy the fallback list.

Minimality fails: the operation rewrites the whole clause (53 to 115 words, 0.838 changed-character ratio). Mutuality and scope could be achieved by narrower edits ('EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY', deleting 'SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11') with the carve-out definition and payment-obligation sentence added as a separate concise insertion.
Extra words beyond what the position requires: 'TOTAL AGGREGATE' and the added 'INCIDENTAL' damages category.
Unrelated terms are untouched, 'EXCLUDED CLAIMS' is defined in-line, and no dangling mechanic or contradiction is introduced, so intent is preserved.
